questions.stem: In quadrilateral KLMN shown, KL = 5, LM = 5, KN = 21, and MN = 21. Diagonals KM and LN (not shown) intersect at point G (not shown), where GK = 1 and GM = 1. If the length of diagonal LN is (√p + √w), where p and w are integers, what is the value of p + w?

ledger.recompute: KL=LM=5、KN=MN=21 → 关于 KM 轴对称的风筝形，LN⊥KM 于 G；GK=GM=1。Rt△GKL：GL=√(25−1)=√24；Rt△GKN：GN=√(441−1)=√440；LN=√24+√440 → p=24, w=440 → p+w=464。册内扫描页未印该题答案，以独立复算为准。

questions.stem: In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is x°, the measure of angle Y is y°, and the measure of angle Z is 33°. If x > y > 33, which of the following additional pieces of information is NOT sufficient to determine the values of x and y?
